name: Shinomiya Ryouhei
source:
Likes: Naps
Kazami Academy Second Year Class 2

He's good at sports as well as schoolwork and is admired by the female students. However he has a pretty blunt personality and a bad mouth.
Contrary to his looks he's good at cooking and is in charge of housework in the Shinomiya household.
